Only the call to the members' vote of 18 October 2012 (PDF p. 1) is imported; the issue predates the vote and prints no result. rows.text: The issue calls members to the 'Élection du Premier secrétaire, votez le 18 octobre !' before the 76th congress at Toulouse of 26, 27 and 28 October, and prints the professions de foi of Harlem Désir and Emmanuel Maurel.
